scenicChapters.title: Avenue of the Volcanoes
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 46 km this is Avenue of the Volcanoes, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-segment-palcanan-grande-palcanan-.story: From Alausí it runs 321 km to Alausí; allow about 5 h 32 of riding. The stops in between: Segment El Tambo - Honorato Vásquez, Segment Cerro de Cojitambo, Segment Llaviuco - Llaviuco and Segment San Antonio - San Antonio. The highest point is about 3,800 m. The line favours views over speed.
